recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is required for FHIR-19915 unless a human separately wants optional editorial retitling of example descriptions.
issue_request: FHIR-19915 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised in STU3 and applied for R5, asking to add MedicationRequest and MedicationDispense examples that include a future-dated timing.event with repeat.boundsPeriod.
initial_application: The Jira comment records the work as committed and merged in ec284380a4c273eeee93dc77e0ead3366dddec01. The implementation commit cdb9b154325715da80c5913ec7939955b7d52105 names GF 19915 and added source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense0332.xml while adding timing.event and repeat.boundsPeriod to source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0318.xml.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription has since become MedicationRequest. MedicationRequest and MedicationDispense are active, approved resources in source/fhir.ini, and their current example list resources register MedicationRequest/medrx0318 and MedicationDispense/meddisp0332. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this narrow example request.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed: medicationrequest0318.xml contains timing.event 2020-01-01 with boundsPeriod 2020-01-01 through 2020-01-10, and medicationdispense0332.xml contains timing.event 2020-01-15T22:00:00+11:00 with boundsPeriod 2020-01-15 through 2020-01-20.
